$comment: The ONE place the agent's character lives. Change the face, the name, the voice or the languages here and nothing else: the frontend (dock, call tile, still photo, greeting copy, alt text, language toggle) and the brain (voice per language, greetings, prompt, Hindi self-forms) both read this file. A voice must speak every language it is listed for (the speech tier's /voices.json says which); `gender` picks the Hindi first-person forms in the prompt. `character` also picks the idle dock's still photo, frontend/src/characters/<character>.webp. `roles` is the dock's label per job (the brain's job_for: /admissions, /apply, /scholarships and /campus-life are the counsellor, every other page the advisor).
